text.en:
Article IV, Chapter II of Part XIX on National Security is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Article IV Veterans Services
"1. The Veterans Memorial Hospital, the Veterans Claims Settlement Staff, the National Shrines Commission,
(all under the Department of National Defense), and the Philippine Veterans Administration (under the Office
of the President) are consolidated and integrated into only one agency in the department to be known as the
Philippine Veterans Affairs Office.
"2. The Philippine Veterans Affairs Office, hereinafter referred to as the Office, shall administer all benefits
due to veterans, their heirs and beneficiaries; shall provide medical care and treatment to veterans pursuant to
existing laws, and shall administer, maintain and develop military memorials and battle monuments
proclaimed as national shrines.
"a. A Veterans Memorial Hospital which shall be essentially the existing Veterans Memorial Hospital;
"b. A claims and Pensions Branch which shall perform the functions of the present Philippine Veterans
Administration and the Veterans Claims Settlement Staff. For this purpose, the latter agencies are abolished
and the applicable appropriations, records, equipment, property and such personnel as may be necessary are
transferred to the Claims and Pensions Branch of the Office; and
"c. A Military Shrines Service which shall perform the functions of the National Shrines Commission
pertaining to military memorials. For which purpose, the latter office is abolished and the applicable office is
abolished and the applicable appropriations, records, equipment, property and such personnel as may be

necessary are transferred to the Military Shrines Service of the Philippine Veterans Affairs Office."

Section 7, Article XV, Chapter I, Part XII on Education, providing for the abolition of the
National Shrines Commission and the transfer of its functions to the National historical Institute of the
Department of Education and Culture is hereby repealed.

The Secretary of National Defense shall issue the necessary order and guidelines to implement
this decree.

This decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City, of Manila, this 26th day of January, the year of Our Lord nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
